tex_content.html:
Definition
[Convex subbundle and fiberwise preserving vector fields] ↗ def:vector-field-preserves-convex-set

For a vector bundle $\pi :{\mathcal V}\to M$ and closed ${\mathcal Z}\subset {\mathcal V}$, call ${\mathcal Z}$ convex when every fiber $Z_x$ is convex. A fiberwise vector field on a neighborhood ${\mathcal U}$ preserves ${\mathcal Z}$ when its restriction to each fiber preserves $Z_x$.
